error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: SEMOSS Code ran into an error it could not recover from. Reloading the page usually fixes it.

transcript.label: Transcript
transcript.firstRun: Type a prompt and press Enter to run the agent. Type :help to list commands and keys.

question.invalid: The agent asked a question this console cannot show. Dismiss it to let the run go on.

transcript.droppedEvents: Earlier events were dropped from the live feed ({{n}}).
transcript.unknownItem: This item cannot be shown here ({{kind}}).

run.failedUnknown: Run failed. The server gave no reason.
run.lost: Lost contact with this run. It may still be running on the server.
run.approvalHint: Type :approve to allow it, or :deny to reject it.
run.awaitingAnswer: The agent is asking for your input.

session.busy: A run is in progress. Wait for it to finish, or type :stop.
session.noModel: No model is available. A model appears here once it is tagged text-generation.
session.unknownHarness: No harness named "{{name}}". Type :harness to list them.
session.unknownModel: No model named "{{name}}". Type :model to list them.
session.switchHarnessHint: Type :harness followed by a name to switch.
session.switchModelHint: Type :model followed by a name or an id to switch.
session.answerInForm: The agent asked a question. Answer it in the form, or type :deny to dismiss it.
session.saveFailed: Could not save the room settings: {{message}}
session.newRoom: New room. It is saved when you send the first prompt.

command.unknown: Unknown command :{{name}}. Type :help to list commands.
command.missingName: Type a command name after the colon, or :help to list commands.
command.harness: Show the harnesses, or switch to one
command.model: Show the models, or switch to one
command.clear: Clear the screen (the room keeps its history)
command.approve: Allow the tool call that is waiting
command.deny: Reject the tool call that is waiting
command.export: Save the last run's raw events as JSON

help.literalColon: To send a prompt that starts with a colon, type two colons.
